name: @uni-helper/devtools
description: Uni DevTools 门面包：聚合探针 / node 中继 / Vite·Webpack 插件 / MCP / 面板，并自带 CLI

scripts.build: pnpm run build:index && pnpm run build:cli && node ../../scripts/build-dts.mjs
scripts.build:index: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:devframe --external:"devframe/*" --external:@uni-helper/devtools-vite --external:@uni-helper/devtools-webpack --external:@uni-helper/devtools-mcp --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import{createRequire as __uniCr}from'node:module';import{fileURLToPath as __uniFu}from'node:url';import{dirname as __uniDn}from'node:path';const require=__uniCr(import.meta.url);const __filename=__uniFu(import.meta.url);const __dirname=__uniDn(__filename);"
